name: Kiro — Specs and custom agents
date_note: Pages carry no publication date; captured 2026-10-10.
summary: An agentic IDE/CLI where specs (requirements.md, design.md, tasks.md) structure the work, built-in and custom agents do it, and hooks automate checks inside the session.
source_phases: Requirements or Bug Analysis · Design · Tasks

members.v21_note: Mentioned only in an example pattern, not a defined role.

gaps.text: No product owner, QA or architect is defined as a role; the human is a generic user ('Your role').

citation.section: §2 Kiro: Specs and Custom agents — Roles

gaps.text: Checks run inside the agent session (hooks, optional property-based tests); the reviewed specs and agents docs do not mention CI/CD gates or architecture rules, which live in design.md and steering as context.

citation.section: §5.1 Architecture rules checked in CI (fitness functions) — Kiro

gaps.text: Kiro Web can plan changes across several repositories in one spec session, but the reviewed docs do not say how the cross-repo result is verified.
